title: 关系
Relations
text: 在非空集合 S 中，对任意两个元素 a、b，都能确定条件 R 是否成立，就得到 S 上的一个关系。也可用有序对的集合 R ⊆ S × S 表示。
A relation on a nonempty set S specifies, for every pair a, b, whether a R b holds. Equivalently, it is a subset R of S × S.

title: 关系的函数表示
Relations as functions
notebook.formula:
R : S × S → {0, 1}
或 R : S × S → {F, T}
text: 把关系看成一个判断函数：R(a,b) = 1（或 T）表示 a 与 b 有关系，R(a,b) = 0（或 F）表示没有关系。其中 F = False，T = True。这与用有序对的集合定义关系完全等价。

A relation can be viewed as a truth-valued function: R(a,b) = 1 (or T) means that a is related to b; R(a,b) = 0 (or F) means it is not. Here F = False and T = True. This is equivalent to describing a relation as a set of ordered pairs.
notebook.formulaEn:
R : S × S → {0, 1}
or R : S × S → {F, T}
detail: 函数形式便于扩展：把值域换成 [0,1]，得到 R : S × S → [0,1]，就能表达关系的程度，而不只回答“有”或“无”。在明确的随机模型中，也可以令 R(a,b) 表示事件“a 与 b 有关系”的概率，从而与概率论联系起来。一般的关系程度或隶属度不自动等于概率，概率解释需要相应的随机模型。

The function viewpoint is easy to extend: R : S × S → [0,1] can express a degree of relatedness instead of only yes or no. In a specified random model, R(a,b) may instead be the probability of the event that a is related to b, connecting the idea to probability theory. A general degree or membership value is not automatically a probability; that interpretation requires a random model.

title: 等价关系
Equivalence relations
notebook.formula:
a ∼ a
a ∼ b ⇒ b ∼ a
a ∼ b, b ∼ c ⇒ a ∼ c
text: S 上的关系同时具有反身性、对称性和传递性，称为等价关系。三个条件都须对集合中的所有相应元素成立。
An equivalence relation is reflexive, symmetric and transitive. Each condition must hold for every relevant choice of elements in S.

title: 等价类与商集
Classes and quotients
text: 等价类 [a] 是与 a 等价的全部元素组成的子集。全部不同的等价类组成商集。右图以模 m 的同余关系为例：类是商集的元素。
The class [a] consists of all elements equivalent to a. The quotient is the set of distinct classes. The diagram uses congruence modulo m: each whole class becomes one quotient element.

title: 集合的分类
Partitions
text: 把 S 写成若干两两不相交的非空子集的并，就得到一种分类。每个元素恰好属于其中一个类：不遗漏，也不重复。
A partition expresses S as a union of pairwise disjoint nonempty subsets. Every element belongs to exactly one block.

title: 等价关系与分类的对应
Relations and partitions
text: 每个等价关系的全部等价类构成一个分类。反过来，每个分类都确定一个等价关系：两元素等价当且仅当它们属于同一类。这两个构造互为逆过程。
The distinct equivalence classes form a partition. Conversely, a partition defines an equivalence relation by membership in the same block. The two constructions are inverse to each other.

title: 自测
Self-check
text: 先独立判断，再选择答案。每题标明教材来源与难度；选择后查看理由并逐步展开证明。
Make your own judgment before choosing an answer. Each question identifies its textbook source and difficulty; then review the explanation and proof steps.

title: 关系的性质
Properties of a relation
q: 在 S = {a,b} 上取 R = {(a,a)}。下列哪组恰好列出 R 满足的性质？
On S = {a,b}, let R = {(a,a)}. Which list contains exactly the properties satisfied by R?
reason: R 不含 (b,b)，因此不反身；它满足对称性与传递性。
R is not reflexive because (b,b) is missing. It is symmetric and transitive.
proof: 若 xRy，则 x = y = a，所以 yRx。
If xRy, then x = y = a, hence yRx.
若 xRy 且 yRz，则 x = y = z = a，所以 xRz。
If xRy and yRz, then x = y = z = a, hence xRz.

title: 映射与等价类
A map and its classes
q: 令 φ: ℤ → ℤ，φ(n) = n²，并规定 a ∼ b ⇔ φ(a) = φ(b)。[3] 等于哪个集合？
Let φ: ℤ → ℤ be φ(n) = n², and define a ∼ b iff φ(a) = φ(b). Which set is [3]?
reason: 与 3 同类等价于 n² = 9，整数解为 −3 和 3。
Being equivalent to 3 means n² = 9, whose integer solutions are −3 and 3.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 子集的分类
A partition of subsets
q: 设 A = {1,2,3}。在 P(A) 中，两个子集当且仅当元素个数相同才等价。商集有多少个元素？
Let A = {1,2,3}. Two members of P(A) are equivalent iff they have the same cardinality. How many elements does the quotient have?
reason: 子集的大小可以是 0、1、2、3，恰有四个等价类。
The possible cardinalities are 0, 1, 2 and 3, giving four classes.
proof: 每个子集的大小唯一，且四种大小都能取到。
Every subset has a unique size, and all four sizes occur.
商集的元素是四个类，而非八个子集。
The quotient contains four classes, not eight subsets.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。

title: 有理数上的关系
A relation on the rationals
q: 在 ℚ 上规定 a ∼ b ⇔ a − b ∈ ℤ。下列哪个数与 1/3 等价？
On ℚ, define a ∼ b iff a − b ∈ ℤ. Which number is equivalent to 1/3?
reason: 7/3 − 1/3 = 2 ∈ ℤ。其余三个差均不是整数。
The difference 7/3 − 1/3 = 2 is an integer; the other three differences are not.
proof: 每个类恰在 ℚ ∩ [0,1) 中有一个代表元。
Each class has exactly one representative in ℚ ∩ [0,1).
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。
Return to the cited textbook exercise and write a complete argument with its assumptions.

title: 类中的元素数
The size of a class
q: 设 A = {1,2,3,4}，子集按大小等价。[{1,2}] 中有多少个元素？
Let A = {1,2,3,4}, with subsets equivalent by size. How many elements belong to [{1,2}]?
reason: 这个类由所有二元子集组成，共 C(4,2) = 6 个。
This class consists of the two-element subsets; there are C(4,2) = 6.
proof: 这里计算类的大小；整个商集则有五个类。
This counts the size of one class; the entire quotient has five classes.
extension: 回到对应教材习题，写出所用条件与完整论证。

title: 取整映射
A floor map
q: 令 φ: ℤ → ℤ，φ(n) = ⌊n/3⌋。按 φ(a) = φ(b) 定义等价关系。等价类 [−1] 是哪个集合？
Let φ: ℤ → ℤ be φ(n) = ⌊n/3⌋, and define equivalence by φ(a) = φ(b). What is [−1]?
reason: Since φ(−1) = −1, the condition is ⌊n/3⌋ = −1, equivalently −3 ≤ n < 0.
proof: 向下取整是满足 −1 ≤ n/3 < 0。
The floor condition is −1 ≤ n/3 < 0.
其中的整数恰为 −3、−2、−1。
The integers in this interval are −3, −2 and −1.

title: 合并两种关系
Combining two relations
q: S = {a,b,c} 上，R 对应分类 {{a,b},{c}}，T 对应 {{a},{b,c}}。包含 R ∪ T 的最小等价关系有几个等价类？
On S = {a,b,c}, R corresponds to {{a,b},{c}} and T to {{a},{b,c}}. How many classes does the smallest equivalence relation containing R ∪ T have?
reason: a 与 b 必须同类，b 与 c 也必须同类；传递性使三个元素属于同一类。
a must be equivalent to b, and b to c. Transitivity puts all three elements in one class.
proof: 任何包含 R ∪ T 的等价关系都必须包含 a ∼ c。
Any equivalence relation containing R ∪ T must also have a ∼ c.
S × S 本身满足要求，且上述条件已迫使所有元素同类。
S × S satisfies the requirement, and the conditions force a single class.

title: 三元素集上的计数
Counting on a three-element set
q: 三元素集合 S = {a,b,c} 上一共有多少种不同的等价关系？
How many distinct equivalence relations exist on S = {a,b,c}?
reason: 等价关系与分类一一对应：一类有 1 种，两类有 3 种，三类有 1 种。
Equivalence relations correspond to partitions: one has one block, three have two blocks, and one has three blocks.
proof: 两类时，选择单独成类的元素，共有 3 种。
For two blocks, choose the singleton element in three ways.
The total is 1 + 3 + 1 = 5.

title: 有理数的两种差
Two conditions on rational numbers
q: 在 ℚ 上规定 a ∼ b ⇔ a−b ∈ ℤ 或 a+b ∈ ℤ。下列哪个集合在每个等价类中恰好取到一个代表元？
On ℚ, define a ∼ b iff a−b ∈ ℤ or a+b ∈ ℤ. Which set contains exactly one representative from every class?
reason: 先把 q 模整数化到 [0,1)，再把 t 与 1−t 识别，可唯一取到 [0,1/2] 中的代表元。
First reduce modulo integers to [0,1), then identify t with 1−t. This yields a unique representative in [0,1/2].
proof: a ∼ b 可写成 a = εb + k，其中 ε ∈ {1,−1}、k ∈ ℤ；这也证明传递性。
Write a = εb + k with ε ∈ {1,−1} and k ∈ ℤ. Composing this form proves transitivity.
若 u,v ∈ [0,1/2]，u−v 为整数或 u+v 为整数都迫使 u=v。
For u,v ∈ [0,1/2], either u−v ∈ ℤ or u+v ∈ ℤ forces u=v.

title: 同时满足两个条件
Two simultaneous conditions
q: 在 ℤ 上规定 a ∼ b ⇔ 4 | (a−b) 且 6 | (a−b)。商集有多少个元素？
On ℤ, define a ∼ b iff 4 divides a−b and 6 divides a−b. How many elements does the quotient have?
reason: 同时被 4 与 6 整除等价于被其最小公倍数 12 整除。
Divisibility by both 4 and 6 is equivalent to divisibility by their least common multiple, 12.
proof: 每个类为 r + 12ℤ。
Every class is r + 12ℤ.
r = 0,1,…,11 给出十二个互不相同的类。
The representatives r = 0,1,…,11 give twelve distinct classes.
